envelope.rationale: Union of the Phase-1 TransJakarta shape extent and verified target-rail terminal coordinates, expanded by a 5 km geodesic engineering buffer.

coverage: Incidental non-transit OSM nodes in existing filtered spatial extract only; no comprehensive residential, business or street coverage; coordinates not independently verified. Private/no-access and transit objects excluded. Nodes only; no polygon/relation centroids.
